svg.title: KVM 会话
svg.desc: KVM 会话工具栏及电源、启动菜单。
svg.metadata: Session widths: 520 / 336 / 240 logical px. Toolbar height 44; video gap 16. At 480 and above show text actions. Below 480 show all five 32px icon actions and a 32px connection status action. Below the complete icon row minimum of 264, move power and boot into the downward overflow menu. Outer padding 22 + monitor/status 58 + five icons 160 + six gaps 24 = 264. Native mapping: src/plugins/bmc_ikvm/views.zig and styles.zig. Minimum checked session width 228. Hostname belongs to the session header.
